en: The Section on the Training Rules (Sekhiyakaṇḍa)
The Training Rule on Being Veiled.
At that time, the Buddha, the Blessed One, was dwelling at Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.
Now at that time, the group-of-six monks were walking through inhabited areas with their heads covered...
[as before] ... "The training is to be observed: 'I will not walk through an inhabited area with my head covered.
One should not walk through an inhabited area with one's head covered.
Whoever, out of disrespect, goes through an inhabited area with his head covered, commits an offense of wrong-doing (dukkaṭa).
There is no offense if it was unintentional … [and so forth] …
thus ends the third training rule.
